subject: Driving me mad - can't get isolate() and server-side updateSelectizeInput() to play nice

messages.author: 197c77e14e1565ce
messages.subject: Driving me mad - can't get isolate() and server-side updateSelectizeInput() to play nice
parts:
I'm building a shiny app where there are some very large input lists to search against (nearly 20,000 genes). So, naturally I want to move the selectize over the server. But this is having annoying behavior when combined with isolate. I use an actionButton() to generate the plot. But when the page first loads, using server-side updateSelectizeInput() results in a null gene (I think) being sent to my plotting function. So an error immediately gets printed on first load. This goes away after clicking the actionButton. 

Here's a toy example which (kind of) shows the problem. On inital load the ggplot isn't being plotted for the selected gene. Only when I hit the actionButton does the plot appear. How do I modify this to pass the selected 'gene' to the output$boxPlot on load?

server.R:
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)

genes <- c('A','B')
expression <- cbind(rbind(10,100),genes) %>% data.frame()
colnames(expression) <- c('Expression','Gene')

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  updateSelectizeInput(session, 'Gene', choices = genes, selected='A', server = TRUE)
  
  output$boxPlot <- renderPlot({
    input$pan_button
    isolate({
      input.gene <- input$Gene
      plot_data <- expression %>% filter(Gene %in% input.gene)
      ggplot(plot_data, aes(x=Gene,y=as.numeric(as.character(Expression)))) + geom_bar(stat='identity') + ylim(0,100)
    })
  })  
})





ui.R
library(shiny)

fluidPage( actionButton('pan_button','Re-draw Plot!'),
           selectizeInput('Gene',strong('Gene:'), choices = NULL, selected='ABCA4'), 
           plotOutput('boxPlot'))

messages.subject: Re: Driving me mad - can't get isolate() and server-side updateSelectizeInput() to play nice
parts:
Yes, the req() solves one problem. The weirdness I had was because I forgot I was ALSO using some inputs to dynamically resize the plot. So I had to also use req() on that function.

The other problem (having nothing initially loaded), was solved by using if else statements with the actionButtons.

Here's an updated 'solved' toy example:

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)

genes <- c('A','B','C')
expression <- cbind(rbind(10,100,25),genes) %>% data.frame()
colnames(expression) <- c('Expression','Gene')
load_plot <- ggplot(expression %>% filter(Gene %in% genes[c(1,2)]), aes(x=Gene,y=as.numeric(as.character(Expression)))) + geom_bar(stat='identity') + ylim(0,100)

ui <- fluidPage(
  actionButton('pan_button','Re-draw Plot!'),
  selectizeInput('Gene',strong('Gene:'), choices = NULL, selected='ABCA4', multiple = TRUE), 
  plotOutput('boxPlot')
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

updateSelectizeInput(session, 'Gene', choices = genes, selected=c('A','B'), server = TRUE)
  
  output$boxPlot <- renderPlot({
    input$pan_button
    if (input$pan_button==0){load_plot}
    else{

isolate({
        input.gene <- input$Gene
        plot_data <- expression %>% filter(Gene %in% input.gene)
        ggplot(plot_data, aes(x=Gene,y=as.numeric(as.character(Expression)))) + geom_bar(stat='identity') + ylim(0,100)
      })
    }
  })  
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

On Monday, March 20, 2017 at 8:58:16 AM UTC-7, David M wrote:
Yes, the req() solves one problem. The weirdness I had was because I forgot I was ALSO using some inputs to dynamically resize the plot. So I had to also use req() on that function.

The other problem (having nothing initially loaded), was solved by using if else statements with the actionButtons.

Here's an updated 'solved' toy example:

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)

genes <- c('A','B','C')
expression <- cbind(rbind(10,100,25),genes) %>% data.frame()
colnames(expression) <- c('Expression','Gene')



load_plot <- ggplot(expression %>% filter(Gene %in% genes[c(1,2)]), aes(x=Gene,y=as.numeric(as.character(Expression)))) + geom_bar(stat='identity') + ylim(0,100)

ui <- fluidPage(
  actionButton('pan_button','Re-draw Plot!'),
  selectizeInput('Gene',strong('Gene:'), choices = NULL, selected='ABCA4', multiple = TRUE), 
  plotOutput('boxPlot')
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  updateSelectizeInput(session, 'Gene', choices = genes, selected=c('A','B'), server = TRUE)
  
  output$boxPlot <- renderPlot({
    input$pan_button
    if (input$pan_button==0){load_plot}
    else{
      isolate({
        input.gene <- input$Gene
        plot_data <- expression %>% filter(Gene %in% input.gene)
        ggplot(plot_data, aes(x=Gene,y=as.numeric(as.character(Expression)))) + geom_bar(stat='identity') + ylim(0,100)
      })
    }
  })  
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
